name: Amlodipine + Losartan
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Essential hypertension (substitution for the separate drugs)
usual_adult_dose.dose: One tablet once daily; usual 5 mg/50 mg; maximum 5 mg/100 mg

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Aliskiren; other ARBs or ACE inhibitors (dual RAAS blockade)

key_interactions.action: Contraindicated in this PI; if a specialist combines them, monitor potassium closely. This restriction is specific to this fixed-dose product; with separately dosed losartan, mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (spironolactone, finerenone) are used in CKD with potassium monitoring.

key_interactions.effect: Less blood-pressure effect; worsening kidney function.
Listed as contraindicated with ARBs in this PI.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (ketoconazole, itraconazole, ritonavir), diltiazem

contraindications: Bilateral renal artery stenosis or stenosis to a single kidney
Angioedema with ACE inhibitors or ARBs; hereditary or idiopathic angioedema
monitoring: Creatinine and potassium before starting and periodically

pk.half_life: Losartan about 2 hours; E-3174 6 to 9 hours; amlodipine 30 to 50 hours
pk.half_life_eskd: Losartan AUC about 2-fold higher on hemodialysis; E-3174 unchanged; amlodipine unchanged
pk.protein_binding: Losartan and E-3174 99% or more; amlodipine about 93%
pk.metabolism: Losartan converted to active E-3174; amlodipine about 90% hepatic to inactive metabolites
pk.excretion_renal_pct: Losartan about 4% unchanged and about 6% as E-3174 in urine
pk.dialyzability: Losartan and E-3174 no; amlodipine not stated

sources.citation: Organon South Africa (Pty) Ltd. (2025). AMZAAR 5/50 and 5/100 tablets (amlodipine camsylate/losartan potassium) [Professional information; revised November 30, 2025]. South African Health Products Regulatory Authority (SAHPRA) PI/PIL repository.

Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD Work Group. (2024). KDIGO 2024 clinical practice guideline for the evaluation and management of chronic kidney disease. Kidney International, 105(4S), S117–S314.

revision_log.change: Potassium-sparing diuretic row labeled product-specific; MRAs used with separately dosed losartan under potassium monitoring. The proposal's '1 and 4 weeks' check interval was not published (not verified).
